notes.title: Space Fox Kimi is now Free to Play!
notes.content:
Wow I never made announcements here, huh? Well, how’s this for the first one: Space Fox Kimi is now free to play!

As you may know, I’ve since remade Space Fox Kimi into [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789050/Fuchian_Chronicles/]Fuchian Chronicles[/url], which has now been out for a year. To celebrate the anniversary, I’ve decided to make Space Fox Kimi permanently free to play! So what’s new in Fuchian Chronicles? Have a look for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33467411/d4579bf605ac6980bcf74d44684c40a5aebc0844.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33467411/6769a15d1ccaeb7df7f20878bafaaebefffb88df.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33467411/1f7649c08209289adcc2a57765236214fff72284.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33467411/fd1da08a48765d5e1c16daf7760d79a404c486f3.png[/img]

Visual quality and gameplay improvements aside, the main difference between Fuchian Chronicles and Space Fox Kimi is that the narrative is far more focused in the remake and doesn’t have as many “random plot threads that go nowhere”. That’s not to say there aren’t similarities, and you’ll find a couple familiar plot points if you’ve played both, especially in the first three chapters. 

Thanks for your time, I hope you’ll check out Fuchian Chronicles! It’s on sale for a week starting with this announcement. It also has a demo with a standalone side story. There are plans for a sequel, but due to personal circumstances won’t be working on it anytime soon. I’ll post any updates on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/shentzugames.bsky.social]bluesky [/url]when they become available. 

Best,
ShenTzu

notes.title: Announcing Fuchian Chronicles!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33467411/bd3b0baa6c2043892b016e09cc874de857a362da.png[/img]

Announcing Fuchian Chronicles, a remake of Space Fox Kimi!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789050/Fuchian_Chronicles/

I know I previously stated that I would like to make a sequel, but after looking at Space Fox Kimi again, I decided that doing a remake first would be best. Space Fox Kimi is my first game as a developer, and it definitely shows. Since the sequel will be heavily impacted by the events of the first game, I would hate it if players were turned off from playing the sequel because of how rough the original is. I’d like to make it a feature where your choices in the first game affect part of the sequel, so having a more polished first game will help a lot there too.

Don’t worry though, it won’t be a pure remake. In addition to significant graphical improvements and a new combat system, I will be tweaking the story as well. Many of the original plot points will still be there, but there will also be additional story bits to expand on the universe and background. 

Another thing I should note about Fuchian Chronicles is that it’ll be released episodically in Early Access. This so I can get more feedback and help in playtesting so there won’t be another game breaking bug that I missed for years (again, my apologies for that). I’m still a solo developers and don’t have the resources/connections to playtest the game extensively, so your help in doing so is greatly appreciated. The price of the game will increase gradually as more chapters are released, but they won’t be sold separately. This means that if you buy the game early on, you will get the full game at a significant discount as my thanks for supporting me while the game is in development. Please read the Early Access notes in the store page for more details.

Barring any real life issues, I’m planning to release the Prologue and Chapter One early to mid-December 2021. I hope you enjoy the game, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Game Breaking Bug Fixed!
notes.content:
The bug where you get hardlocked after seeing a certain scene in Chapter 3 of the game has now been fixed! Please load your latest save and revisit the area and it should be working now.

My sincerest apologies for the long delay, I wasn't aware of the bug until now because I had stopped checking the community tab. Thank you for your patience, and I hope those who were stuck there enjoy the rest of the game!

notes.title: Future of the series and new game released!
notes.content:
First of all, my second full game, Death and Progress, is now available on Steam!

Get it here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125420/Death_and_Progress/

Alternatively if you want to support me more, you can get the game DRM free on itch.io here! https://shentzu.itch.io/death-and-progress


Now, some of you have asked whether or not I'll be making a sequel to Space Fox Kimi, and I've responded to the comments, but I think it's good to have a proper announcement about it.

I fully intend to make a sequel to Space Fox Kimi, but I want to be able to make a quality game that does the story I have in mind justice. As such I've been experimenting with new techniques, new maps, and new gameplay elements that will all contribute to the sequel. I currently have a collab project with the people behind the Mermaid's Wrath mod for World of Warships planned (more info on it as it becomes available), but after that I will likely begin work on the sequel.

RPGMaker has been a great engine and basically launched my career, but I would like to transition to something else if it's feasible. I'll be exploring my options, and if possible I'd like to make the sequel a 3rd person RPG. No promises right now, but it's my next step as a game developer, so to speak.

That's it for now. Thank you for your support so far, and I hope you continue to support my games!

Best,
~ShenTzu

notes.title: Christmas DLC and Special Announcement
notes.content:
I have a couple of announcements this time. It’s probably going to end up more like a blog type post so please bear with me here.

First of all, the Christmas DLC: “A Very Kimi Christmas” is now released and available for free to owners of Space Fox Kimi. It’s a short, silly, non-canon story about the foxes’ first Christmas on Earth. I wanted to release this in time for Christmas, but a last minute trip overseas made that impossible. Hopefully you’ll still like it.

Second, I’m afraid this DLC will be the last one I’ll be releasing for the foreseeable future. While I would love make other DLC to flesh out other aspects of the story and universe, I am a solo indie game developer with bills to pay, and unfortunately free DLC doesn’t really help with that. So with that in mind, I will be moving onto my next game (more on this later). Thank you for understanding.

Thirdly, a bit of good news. I am a new developer and this is my first game, and I realized that it was more important for more people to play my game and give feedback. As such Space Fox Kimi will be permanently discounted to $0.99 USD effective immediately (if you still see it as $4.99 please wait for Steam to update the price). If you do play my game, please let me know about anything you liked or disliked about it, be it story, gameplay, level design, anything. Leaving a review on Steam would be most helpful, but if you prefer you can send me a message on twitter (@ShenTzuGames) or e-mail me at shentzugames@yahoo.com. 

I am also looking for feedback on what my next game should be. Some of you have expressed interest in a sequel to Space Fox Kimi, and that is one option. I also have plans for a completely different story that’s modern-fantasy themed. Please let me know which one you’d be more interested in on this Twitter poll here: https://twitter.com/ShenTzuGames/status/1078776586046853120

Thank you for your support thus far, and I hope you continue to enjoy my games.

Happy holidays,
~ ShenTzu

notes.title: Game Rebalance
notes.content:
It has come to my attention that parts of the game are unnecessarily difficult. After thinking about it and doing some more testing, I realized that was the case and made the following changes:

- Buffed maximum energy of GFE Cruisers to 750 from 330
- Reduced energy cost of “Emergency Repairs” to 50 from 70
- Automatically recover some HP and Energy when entering space in Chapter 3
- Reduced chance of random encounters in Chapter 3

You should still be able to play your existing saves, though it's recommended to load a save that's before entering the space map in Chapter 3.

Please feel free to leave any other feedback for this game that you may have. Thank you!
